# Declaration of Generative AI Use {#sec-ai-declaration}

::: {.callout-warning}

In accordance with the ZHAW declaration requirement for generative AI, the generative AI systems used in the preparation of this thesis are listed below together with their purpose. Prompts and their corresponding outputs are not declared, in line with section 3.III of the directive. A summary narrative of how these systems were used, including their role as a source of inspiration and critical dialogue, is given in the introduction.

## Register of Generative AI Systems

Anthropic. (2026). *Claude* (Opus 4 / Cowork). https://claude.ai

- Research assistance and verification of bibliographic references
- Drafting and reformulation of text passages
- Structuring of chapters and sections
- Editorial checking of formatting and citation consistency

## Scope of Use

All scientific content, data analysis, modelling decisions, and conclusions are the author's own work. Generative AI systems were used as auxiliary tools as listed above and did not replace the author's analytical or interpretive contribution. Every factual claim and every reference that passed through an AI tool was checked by the author against the primary source before inclusion.
